title: Representability of partial sums in generic absolute and positive web models
source_version: Official published FSCD2026.29 CC BY4.0 PDF pp.29:1--23, retrieved2026-10-14; selected target Theorem59 pp.29:16--17 with published AppendixA support and definitions

license.name: CC BY4.0 (official published selected text and faithful editable transcription)

difficulty_reason: The authors construct the summation object D=(N,l-infinity(N)) for generic absolute web models, encode every multi-indexed morphism family as a matrix h, identify its tensor powers by predual double orthogonality, and prove summability iff that matrix is a web morphism using the covering principle and predual summability characterization. The direct predual and covering proofs are retained; this is a non-routine categorical/matrix representation construction supporting H2, not a separately counted immediate Taylor corollary.
core_obligations: Retain the strong-PCR/absolute-PCR and downward-closed orthogonality-pole hypotheses and original web-object covering conditions.
Retain complete author h-matrix construction, equivalence chain and required covering/predual proofs.
Keep all observed original published notation unchanged; do not repair formulas using the prior arXiv version or add a missing proof case.
